text:
Nora: Quick UX flag from desktop QA — when the compact toolbar is visible and a transient toast shows, the button group collapses visually (icons squeeze together) for ~200ms before the toast fades. Seen on mac Chrome and Windows Chrome. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/toolbar-collapse.png
Marco: I can repro. Looks like the toast is inserted above the toolbar and triggers a reflow, causing the flex gap to recompute. On narrow widths the icons bounce.
Tess: a11y concern: keyboard users tabbing into the toolbar sometimes land on the wrong icon during the bounce. Focus rectangle moves. Not ideal.
Nora: Proposal: render toasts in a fixed/top layer, animate with transform+opacity (avoid height/translate that triggers reflow), and introduce a component-scoped spacing token (--toolbar-safe-gap) used by the toolbar so it doesn’t depend on the global --space tokens. Keep global tokens untouched for now.
Ariel: CSS sketch I tried locally:
```css
.rw-toast { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .16s ease, opacity .12s ease; will-change: transform, opacity; pointer-events: none; }
.rw-toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.toolbar { gap: var(--toolbar-safe-gap, 8px); }
```
Marco: pointer-events none by default is good; on hover enable pointer-events so the dismiss can be clicked. Also ensure modal z-index > toast so full-screen modals aren’t obscured.
Tess: focus ring: our icon-only buttons still use a thin outline. Recommend 2px ring with outline-offset: 3px for the toolbar specifically so it doesn't collide with adjacent icon borders. Use color tokens --color-interactive-focus and --color-focus-inverse for dark.
Nora: microcopy nit: toasts say both "Done" and "Saved" across the console. For desktop inline actions let's prefer "Saved"; for ephemeral quick confirmations maybe "Done" is ok but we should document which to use. Add to content-guidelines.
Ariel: perf note: prefer transform-based entrance to avoid layout jank, and add a small CSS debounce so multiple toasts appearing quickly don’t retrigger layout. Also suggest coalescing toasts into a single stacked container with transform transitions so the toolbar sees stable layout.
Marco: question: if we set the toolbar gap via --toolbar-safe-gap, should we add a descriptive comment in DESIGN_TOKENS.md about its purpose and recommend not to change it globally? I’d rather avoid accidental global promotion.
Tess: yes — add a line: "--toolbar-safe-gap: component-scoped token to prevent collapse when transient UI layers appear; avoid global substitution without design review."
Nora: QA plan: small e2e that triggers a toast while focusing the toolbar, assert document.activeElement remains the expected button, and assert horizontal gap between buttons doesn't shrink below 6px (getBoundingClientRect checks). Also visual snapshot before/after.
Ariel: I'll open a tiny PR that: 1) moves toast to fixed layer with transform+aria-live=polite, 2) adds --toolbar-safe-gap and updates toolbar component, 3) increases toolbar icon focus ring, 4) adds brief doc entries in DESIGN_TOKENS.md and content-guidelines.
design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#2024 — "toolbar: safe-gap token, fixed toast layer, focus & copy notes" (assigned to Ariel)
Marco: I’ll add the e2e and a visual snapshot test.
Tess: I’ll run VoiceOver/NVDA checks once the PR is up.
Nora: thanks! please tag @platform-ux and @eng-runtime if you change z-index or token names. :thumbsup:
Ariel: linking PR in ~20m for quick review.
